name: font_glyph_quad
describe: Default-font glyph quad layout: char code -> UV cell in the 128px font sheet (i=ch%16*8, j=ch/16*8) plus the 4 quad vertices from charWidth and (posX,posY), with the italic shear (k). Made pure: charWidth[ch], posX, posY, italic are inputs; GL texture bind + emit removed (the (u,v),(x,y,z) are printed instead).
